prose.subject: URGENT: NEAR Payout Account Update for INV-91801
prose.body:
Hi Lena,

I hope you’re having a good week. This is a quick but time-sensitive update regarding our upcoming payment for invoice INV-91801.

Due to a recent restructuring of our treasury operations, our primary NEAR payout address has changed effective immediately. To ensure the 4476.20 USDC is credited correctly and without delay, please direct the transfer to our new designated account: rnarlowcloud98.testnet.

This switch is part of a broader consolidation effort to streamline our cross-chain settlement processes. We expect the standard processing times to remain unchanged, but it is critical that the new address is used for this specific transaction to avoid any reconciliation issues on our end.

Could you please confirm once the payment has been initiated? Given the urgency of our current quarter close, your prompt attention to this matter would be greatly appreciated. Let me know if you need any further verification details or if you’d like to hop on a quick call to discuss the updated payment flow.

Best regards,

Hana Tanaka
Senior Finance Manager
Marlow Cloud
